The '''Emergency Relief Area''', also known as the '''Old Sports Ground''' was a sports ground in the southern district of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]] which was taken over by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> following a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly plague]] outbreak. The sports grounds were transformed into the Emergency Refuge Area, a hub for the CSA's relief efforts. Refugees were housed there in encampments and [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Water/Legends|water]] and medicine, including a vaccine were distributed. Refugees residing there were required to wear [[Color/Legends|colored]] neck tags noting when they had received food, water and medicine. CSA security forces patrolled the area to maintain order and wore [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]]. One corner of the sports ground was used as a [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] at which additional supplies could be dropped off.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
